text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I did it! I beat Creek!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I... won.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks... My heart won't stop pounding!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh! Creek...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Well done. You were really impressive
today.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But this doesn't mean that I'm through.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Next time we meet here, I'll be the one
who takes
the victory.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna back down either. I plan
on winning
next time too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Well, we'll see about that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I doubt Creek will go down without a
fight. I've
gotta keep improving.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With hardly a moment to celebrate her
victory,
Oguri Cap is already looking
ahead to their next
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've gotta get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So I want to challenge myself by running
in lots of
different races. I think that's
what I need right
now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Creek will be in next year's
Arima Kinen.
And she'll be at the top of
her game.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So there's no way I'm missing that
race—and
there's no way I'll let myself
lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is more than competent
enough as she
is. All she needs to do
now is keep gaining
experience in G1
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There, she'll be able to polish her skills
by facing
off against many powerful
competitors. Such
experiences will surely
expedite her growth.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right!
choice_data_list: よし、たくさんレースに出よう！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's all fired up! But just as we're about
to
discuss which race to take on next, a
familiar face
interrupts us.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sorry to butt in!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I was watchin' the whole time! Ya did
great,
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Who'da thought ya'd squash Creek like
that?
You're a total superstar!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Tama—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: H-hey, you okay?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm fine. I just feel a little
weak...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because I've been wanting to
see you.
The wave of relief must've been
a little much for
me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, you cut that out!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
D'ya think I'm your momma or somethin'?
'Cause
I'm pretty sure I'm not.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm an Umamusume! Have ya forgotten that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Of course not. What else would
you be?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The heck kind of answer is that? Don'tcha know what that means?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What I'm tryin' to say is dat I'm your rival
as well!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now ya get it! So it's decided! We gotta
go
head-to-head!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I was plannin' on aimin' for the
Dream
Trophy next year.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh really?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Dream Trophy League—a
higher-level league
where Umamusume
who have proven themselves
in the
Twinkle Series compete.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But after seein' your battle with Creek, I
made up
my mind to stay back for a year
and prove I can
beat ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Let's determine once and for all who's
the
best—me, you, or Creek!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Got that, Oguri? I'm your opponent next
time!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I'm fine. All right, let's get to work on
our next
plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's battle with Super Creek may
be over,
but now she has another
powerful rival who wants
to take her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have a lot to mull over. It's
time for
the two of us to get to work.
